notes: New: the PatchMap Manual (Help › PatchMap Manual, ⇧⌘/) opens in its own window with every feature explained and a list of what's changed. Also in this update: zoomed out, the schematic shows device names (zoom in for ports); Find (⌘F); Redo (⇧⌘Z); Delete asks first when gear still has cables; dashed power, dotted USB and double-line fibre with a Key button; a calmer top bar with a saved indicator; a rig summary panel; one line per cable on the patch sheet.
